text:
marta: kicking off a config-only rollout to tweak routing policies and batching params. canary 5% for 30m change window.

sam-ops: thanks — what's the exact config we're pushing?

marta: pushing these changes:
```
routing_policy: prefer-region
max_concurrency_per_model: 80
request_timeout_ms: 12000
batching_window_ms: 12
prefix_cache_ttl_s: 45
rate_limit_tokens_per_minute: 60000
```

leo: batching_window down from 20->12, noted. watch tail latency at p95. threshold: >150ms triggers rollback.

carla: can we pin to model v2.3.1 for the canary? last time v2.4 had perf regressions.

marta: yes pinned to v2.3.1 for canary; global routing still allowed to fall back to v2.4 if capacity issues.

deploy-bot: [deploy] config-only rollout started by marta — env=prod, channel=canary, percent=5, duration=30m, pinned_model=v2.3.1 :rocket:

sam-ops: added alerting: p95 latency >150ms OR 5xx rate >0.8% over 5m. if triggered, automated rollback to previous config.

leo: also logging change: emit routing_policy and batching_window in trace for quick queries.

carla: any impact on Dedicated customers? we should exclude reserved pools.

marta: good call — excluded dedicated pools via selector: pool_type != reserved. included only shared-hosted.

sre-bot: [monitor] canary metrics stream enabled -> dashboards: /dashboards/routing-canary-1876543210

sam-ops: plan for manual check at +10m and +20m. I'll be oncall for the window. @carla you good for +10m?

carla: yep, I'll look at error rates and cost breakdown.

leo: note: cache ttl shortened to 45s to reduce stale route hits — could increase upstream load briefly. watch qps.

deploy-bot: [update] canary reached 5% successfully (t=2m). no immediate errors.

marta: running smoke: /v1/generate with 512 tokens for sampled routes.

carla: smoke ok so far. p50 latency slight uptick (~10ms) but within tolerances.

sam-ops: alerting configured to notify #eng-oncall + paging if thresholds breach.

leo: small concern: max_concurrency 80 might cause queueing for longer sequences. if we see queue-depth increase, we'll drop concurrency to 60 and raise batching_window to 20ms.

marta: noted, adaptive plan ready. rollback criteria reiterated: p95 latency >150ms OR 5xx >0.8% sustained 5m OR queue depth > 12 for >3m.

deploy-bot: [heartbeat] canary @ 12m: p95=128ms, 5xx=0.12%, queue_depth avg=3. No action.

carla: cost delta estimate: +4% token cost due to smaller cache TTL, but expected to stabilize.

sam-ops: continuing monitoring. will call rollback if thresholds crossed.

marta: if all green at 30m, we plan staged ramp: 20% for 20m -> 50% for 20m -> 100% with no model switch. change window total ~90m.

leo: remind ops: have fallback policy in routing that sends traffic to v2.4 if pinned node health drops below 70%.

deploy-bot: [update] canary complete (30m). status=ok. initiating ramp to 20% for 20m.

sam-ops: +1 on proceeding. I'll keep watch for the next 40m.

carla: logging note: add a short flag in rollout metadata explaining this is a config-only cost/latency experiment (for future audits).

marta: added note -> rollout_metadata.experiment = "config-throughput-tuning-2026-03"

sre-bot: [audit] rollout record saved -> id=roll-1876543210, owner=marta, tags=[canary,config-only,route-batching]

leo: if anything flares we can abort and force previous config rollback via deploy-bot. everyone knows the command.

sam-ops: confirmed. abort command tested in staging last week.

deploy-bot: [deploy] ramp to 50% completed. final push to 100% scheduled after cool-off if no issues.

marta: good job all. final note: we left the dedicated pools excluded and pinned model for canary — we'll revisit pinning before full 100% (possible remove pin once stability proven). :thumbsup:

carla: +1, updating release notes draft with summary and rollback criteria.

sam-ops: standing by for final 100% and post-rollout retrospective.

deploy-bot: [final] rollout finished 100% after validation. status=success. timestamps: start=1876543210, end=1876543285.

marta: closing thread, will add PERF/RETRO docs tomorrow.
